The European Electricity Atlas is a priv: The European Electricity Atlas is a private, non-commercial open-source project. It presents publicly available electricity, climate and contextual data in a comparable form. It is neither official statistics nor investment or energy advice.

The Atlas uses no accounts, advertising: The Atlas uses no accounts, advertising or proprietary audience analytics. Merely opening the site does not set a voting cookie.
The public beta is hosted on Railway. Wh: The public beta is hosted on Railway. When the site is requested, the hosting infrastructure processes technically necessary connection data, particularly the IP address, time, requested address and technical status information, to deliver the site and secure its operation. over HTTPS. The server stores only its S: over HTTPS. The server stores only its SHA-256 hash, not the cookie value, together with the image ID, vote direction and timestamps.
The Atlas does not store names, email ad: The Atlas does not store names, email addresses, browser fingerprints or user-agent histories for voting. Click the same direction again to remove an active vote, or the opposite direction to change it. Clearing browser data removes the local association; stored votes can no longer be linked to a visitor without that association.
Votes remain stored until they are remov: Votes remain stored until they are removed or the community database is cleaned up as part of operations. Technical connection data is received by Railway and, only when Europa Overload is enabled, Wikimedia. The Atlas does not send analytics data to advertising or tracking services.
